makePayment.q: How do I make a payment?
makePayment.a: Pay your shop using eSewa, Khalti, or bank transfer, then open Payments and upload a clear screenshot for verification.

uploadScreenshot.q: How do I upload payment screenshot?
uploadScreenshot.a: Go to Payments → Send Screenshot, choose the shop, enter the amount and method, attach the screenshot, then submit.

paymentVerified.a: Your shopkeeper reviews the screenshot. Status shows as Pending, In Review, Verified, or Rejected on the Payments screen.

creditScore.a: Your credit score reflects payment reliability with linked shops. Paying on time helps keep a Good or Excellent score.

scanShopQr.q: How do I scan shop QR code?
scanShopQr.a: Open Scan QR from Home, point your camera at the shop’s My QR code, then confirm to connect.

downloadStatement.a: Open Profile → Statements & Reports or Download Your Statement to export a PDF of your activity.

addCredit.q: How do I add credit for a customer?
addCredit.a: Tap the + tab, choose a customer, enter products and amounts, then save credit.

recordPayment.q: How do I record a payment?
recordPayment.a: Open a customer profile and use Record payment. Enter the amount received and optional note.

exportReports.a: Go to Reports, pick a period, then export the PDF report.

trackExpenses.q: How do I track shop expenses?
trackExpenses.a: Open More → Expenses to add rent, stock, utilities and other costs.

manageProducts.q: How do I manage my product catalog?
manageProducts.a: Open More → Products to add, edit or search products used in credit.

changePassword.q: How do I change my password?
changePassword.a: Go to More → Security to update your password or send a reset email.

serverUnreachable.q: The app says it cannot reach the server
serverUnreachable.a: Check your internet connection. If it continues, contact support — the server may be updating.

addCredit.q: How do I add credit for a customer?
addCredit.a: Tap the + tab at the bottom, choose a customer (or create a new one), enter product name, quantity and price, then Save credit. Use + to add multiple products in one credit.

recordPayment.q: How do I record a payment?
recordPayment.a: Open a customer from Customers, tap their profile, then use Record payment. Enter the amount received and optional note.

exportReports.a: Go to Reports tab, pick Today / This week / This month, then tap Export full PDF report at the bottom.

trackExpenses.q: How do I track shop expenses?
trackExpenses.a: Open More → Expenses. Add rent, stock, utilities and other costs. Filter by month and category.

manageProducts.q: How do I manage my product catalog?
manageProducts.a: Open More → Products to add, edit or search products. Products also save automatically when you add credit.

changePassword.q: How do I change my password?
changePassword.a: Go to More → Security. Enter your current password and a new one, or use Send reset email.

serverUnreachable.q: The app says it cannot reach the server
serverUnreachable.a: Check your internet connection. If the problem continues, contact support — the server may be updating.
